notes: These APIs return synchronous recognition results and expose no resource lifecycle query or asynchronous task identity suitable for polling.

response_notes: Batch recognition responses with message.fail require zero failed items, in addition to statusCode 0. This rejects documented processing failures that still carry a successful HTTP/API envelope. Recognition scores and negative recognition results remain valid results.
Recording recognition has an explicit successful response schema but an abbreviated example with ellipses, so its command has no fabricated fixture.
Business-card response fields differ in case between schema and example; the captured response spelling is displayed once.
The safety-helmet bounding-box description incorrectly refers to a vehicle; its label describes the detection box without copying that unrelated wording.
request_notes: These stateless inference operations do not require resource mutation confirmation and are not automatically retried. The documented appkey header is exposed separately from EOP signing credentials.
